name: Las Viñas bunker (Teruel)
story: The Las Viñas sector around Teruel cemetery was contested from the very start of the war. A defence line on the ridge above the prison watched the Turia riverbed and the old Zaragoza road below the city. This concrete observation fort and bunker is one of its surviving pieces, on the edge of Teruel itself.
see: A thick-walled concrete fort used as an observatory, a rifle post and a bunker.
plan: It is on the Camino de Capuchinos near the cemetery, within walking distance of the centre. Visit together with the city sites.
